programmes.d: A drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds of beavers.

Heaven punishes eight gods for incessant fighting by sending them into the secular world, only able to return once they make accords. Ten thousand years later, a Hong Kong family meets several eccentric people when fleeing from debt collectors.
A brother and sister battle a witch who uses a special blend of marijuana to lure teenagers into her home.
A colorful account of Ilya Mourometz, the legendary 11th-century hero who defended Russia from monsters and invaders.
The mythical Greek hero (Reg Park) rescues a maiden left at the mercy of a beast and goes on to save his son from the sexist queen of lost Atlantis (Fay Spain).
A mysterious professor forces scientists to participate in strange experiments.
To save Dr. Kohmyoji's project after his death, the android Kikaider saves his children so they can complete his work.

A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.
A Mexican revolutionary (Robert Shaw) hides out following a massacre in a small town that left soldiers and townsfolk alike dead.
A bounty hunter, armed with a hatchet instead of a gun, is hired by a crippled mayor to recover a kidnapped woman. Along the way he uncovers a plot to loot silver mines and settles an old score.
Two con artists (James Mason, Gina Lollobrigida) bring an outlaw (Lee Van Cleef) into their scheme to bilk the Mexican government out of $1 million.
